profiles.game_key: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess HD

facts.evidence: The article’s HD-remaster section identifies Tantalus Media and Nintendo EPD as developers of Twilight Princess HD.
Nintendo’s product page identifies Nintendo as publisher of The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess HD.
The article classifies Twilight Princess as an action-adventure game and describes the HD edition as its high-definition remaster.
The HD-remaster section identifies Wii U as the HD edition’s platform; Nintendo’s product page confirms the same platform.
The article’s release table lists the HD edition’s Wii U dates by region; Nintendo’s UK product page independently lists 4 March 2016.
